note: Chapter XXIII: four new pictures for the two holds the stock could not fill (the supper speech, the trance at dawn), drawn by Google to match the Midjourney paintings (16 Nov 2026).
style: A dark, intimate oil painting of 1893 in the manner of the existing paintings: academic realism, deep chiaroscuro, warm candle and lamp light against brown-black shadow, rich glazes, faces lit from one side. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

people.mina: Mina Harker, a young dark-haired Englishwoman of about twenty-five, hair up, a small dark-red cross-shaped burn mark in the centre of her forehead just above the brows
people.jonathan: Jonathan Harker, a grown man of twenty-six with prematurely white hair and a haggard young face, clean-shaven
people.vanhelsing: Professor Van Helsing, an elderly Dutch doctor with short grey hair, bare clean-shaven chin, jaw and upper lip, in a black frock coat

beats.text: At a supper table in a dim London dining room at night, Mina sits holding her husband Jonathan's hand, turning to him and speaking with great tenderness; candle light on their faces, plates and glasses before them, the other men shadowy around the table.

Close on Jonathan at the supper table: his face darkened and drawn with rage, his hand clenched so tightly round Mina's hand that his knuckles are white; Mina beside him does not flinch, looking at him with pleading love. Candle light.

Mina standing at the supper table with tears in her eyes, one hand raised as if begging silence, crying "Oh, hush!"; the men round the table bow their heads, the old professor among them with bowed grey head. Candle light, deep shadow.

A bedroom at grey dawn: Mina sits rigid upright in bed in a white nightgown, eyes closed in a hypnotic trance; the old professor stands over her, staring fixedly at her face, one hand raised; behind them the window blind half drawn up, the cold first light coming in, other men standing very still in the shadows.
